topics.title: Python Decorators
topics.summary: Decorators wrap functions or methods to add behavior (logging, timing, access control) without changing the wrapped function's source code.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to return the wrapper function from the outer function
Not using functools.wraps, which hides the original function metadata
Applying a decorator that expects arguments without using a decorator factory
topics.practice_idea: Create a decorator that logs the function name and arguments each time the wrapped function is called.

topics.title: Python List Comprehensions
topics.summary: List comprehensions build new lists from iterables in a compact expression, often replacing simple for-loops and map/filter patterns.
key_concepts: Syntax [expr for item in iterable if condition]
common_mistakes: Building a comprehension only for side effects instead of using a plain loop
Creating overly nested comprehensions that are hard to read
Shadowing variable names used after the comprehension
topics.practice_idea: Given a list of words, build a list of lengths for words with more than three characters.

topics.title: HTTP Status Codes
topics.summary: HTTP status codes tell clients whether a request succeeded, failed, or needs another action. They are grouped into classes (1xx–5xx).
key_concepts: 4xx client errors (400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found)
When to return which code in APIs
common_mistakes: Returning 200 for every response even when an error occurred
Ignoring status codes when debugging API clients
topics.practice_idea: Match five short scenarios (invalid JSON body, missing route, successful create) to the most appropriate status code.

topics.title: Python Virtual Environments
topics.summary: Virtual environments isolate project dependencies so each project can use its own package versions without affecting the system Python.
common_mistakes: Installing packages globally and then wondering why imports fail in another project
Forgetting to activate the venv before pip install
Committing the venv folder to version control
topics.practice_idea: Create a new venv, install one package, and export the dependency list to a requirements file.

topics.title: Recursion Basics
topics.summary: Recursion solves problems by having a function call itself on smaller subproblems until a base case stops the chain.
common_mistakes: Missing or incorrect base case leading to infinite recursion
Not returning the result of the recursive call when needed
Using recursion when a simple loop is clearer
topics.practice_idea: Write a recursive function that computes factorial of n and trace the calls for n equals 4.

topics.title: JSON and REST APIs
topics.summary: JSON is a common text format for API payloads. REST APIs expose resources over HTTP using methods such as GET and POST.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to call json.loads on a response text body
Assuming keys exist in a JSON object without checking
Sending Python dicts over the wire without serializing to JSON
topics.practice_idea: Parse a sample JSON object representing a user and print only users who have email_verified set to true.
